name: print-social-lavender-gradient-health-billboard-mockup
title: Lavender Health Billboard on Concrete
whatItIs: A large billboard on a concrete wall with a blue-to-lilac gradient, a smiling doctor holding a clipboard, a two-line headline 'Your Health, Smarter Every Day', a short line, logo and URL.
whatItMeans: Soft pastel gradient and a friendly professional make healthcare feel trustworthy and modern.
techniques: Cut-out portrait bleeding to the bottom edge of the board
Large sentence-case headline with short subhead
Pastel gradient for a calm medical tone
Logo and URL along the base
Billboard placed in an architectural scene for scale

vocabulary.definition: A person masked from their background and placed on a design.
A design shown on an outdoor sign in a scene.
A soft blend of light desaturated colours.
